rules.name: The Sunny Scene Rule
rules.body: Keep the light palette in both operating-system color schemes.

dos: Do preserve original PNG artwork and use documented responsive delivery copies.
Do keep essential text and interactions in HTML.
Do retain phone sky fading, subtitle contrast and keyboard access.
Do retain accurate scripted-preview labels and source setup links.
Do preserve native FAQ disclosures, existing source setup and anchor destinations, and skip-link focus behavior.
donts: Don't replace the approved illustration or mascot without owner approval.
Don't describe shader displacement as generated video.
Don't imply live AI, electrical verification from images, Autodesk endorsement or deployment.
